resultados.refuerzo: Cánsion has the accent in the wrong place; canción is stressed on the last syllable.
Platform 3 is the platform the notice gives for the Toledo train.
Platform 10 is a different platform; the notice gives platform 3 for Toledo.
The notice does give a platform, so saying it does not say is wrong.
Lunes a sábado gives the days; the café opens these days from 9:00 to 18:00.
Every day would include Sunday, which does not match the days the café is open.
Only Sundays is the opposite of the answer; the café is open Monday to Saturday.
Water is the drink included in the set menu, so it is the right answer.
Coffee is not the item listed; the set menu includes water.
Dessert is not included; the set menu includes water instead.
Unplugging the device first is the safe step before cleaning it.
Putting the device near water is dangerous and goes against the safety rule.
Switching it on before cleaning is dangerous; the device must be off and unplugged.
With a damaged cord there is a shock risk, so never switch the device on.
Cleaning while plugged in is dangerous, especially when the cord is damaged.
Using the main door has nothing to do with the device; the advice is about the cord.
Desenchufe is the usted command of desenchufar: unplug it, the safe first step.
Encienda is the command to switch on, the opposite of what you need before cleaning.
Conecte is the command to plug in, the opposite of unplugging before cleaning.
Next Monday is the start date given for the new opening hours.
Next Saturday is a different date from the one the report gives.
They have already begun contradicts the future start the question asks about.
Two hours later is the amount of extra time the library closing shows, from Monday to Thursday.
One hour later is the wrong amount; the correct answer is two hours.
The report does give a precise amount of time, so this option is not right.
Students and workers are the two groups whose requests the notice mentions.
Teachers and shopkeepers are not the groups mentioned; students and workers are.
Only tourists is not right; the requests come from students and workers.
Seguirá is the future of seguir: the hours will stay the same on Saturdays.
Seguía is imperfect; the sentence talks about the future, not a past situation.
Siguió is a completed past action; the sentence is about a future situation.
Llovía is imperfect, the tense used to describe background like the weather.
Llegué is a single completed event, not a background description of the scene.
He vuelto is a recent past; background description in a story needs the imperfect.
A single sudden event like came out takes the preterite, not the imperfect.
Walking to school as a child was a habit, shown with the imperfect, not a sudden event.
The week beginning is not the sudden event in the story; it is a general time frame.
Iba is imperfect; cuando era pequeño describes a habitual past, so the imperfect fits.
Fui is preterite, a single completed trip; cuando era pequeño needs the imperfect.
He ido is present perfect; cuando era pequeño points to the imperfect, not to this tense.
